system.description: You have somehow incurred the wrath of Cainites senior to you in the clan, and they have the power to make your unlife miserable — damaging your reputation, spreading nasty gossip, slandering your lovers, and generally making examples of you for reasons you may not even understand. Being abused doesn't mean you must endure it meekly, but finding allies willing to disbelieve the slander, and proving yourself to them, takes real and repeated effort.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans (Toreador)
